train.checkpoint_selection: fixed final12000microsteps only; intermediate states for infrastructure recovery/diagnosis, no test-based selection

compressors.selection: fixed final step; no checkpoint or representation selection

fresh_scenes.selection: first50 native expert-feasible complete replay scenes per task, accepted once before learned-policy testing
fresh_scenes.scene_mode: native eval_mode=True,is_test=True for expert and policy; fixed recorded instruction
fresh_scenes.native_null_grasp_sentinel: prespecified existing exact source/traceback classifier; retain original failures
fresh_scenes.infrastructure_failure: stop and retain; no automatic candidate replacement or retry

evaluation.camera_pose: deterministic +5/-5deg world-z rotation selected by scene-seed parity; same position, wrists unchanged; record pose matrices
evaluation.noise: fresh deterministic per-pixel noise for all3cameras, seed derived from scene/observation step; identical recipes across methods and policy seeds
evaluation.primary_metric: equal-task mean success rate, each of150scenes crossed with3paired training seeds
evaluation.primary_success_rule: PCA clean noninferiority lower95%CI > -5percentagepoints AND mean of3perturbed-condition paired success delta lower95%CI >0 versus SVAE; intersection rule. Otherwise no accuracy-improvement claim.
evaluation.uncertainty: hierarchical paired bootstrap training seeds and scenes within tasks, preserving method/condition pairing; also all per-task/seed rates. Only3trainingseeds limits seed-distribution inference.
secondary_metrics: success and paired deltas versus Wan
translation,rotation,gripper action diagnostics on fixed expert states
real simulator contact records where available; gripper-closing proxy separately labeled
latency,peak memory,compression train time and parameter count
evaluation.failures: technical errors separately counted and retained; an incomplete matrix cannot support the full confirmatory claim

scale_transfer: The controlled300M study is not a5B reproduction. Any full-size adaptation needs its own matched fixed protocol before new outcomes; proceed within explicit full-validation authorization and remaining resource ceiling.
